subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can replace the underlined word in the following sentence.**

Abraham narrated Reshma his last **__escapade__** in a dramatic way.
solution: The correct answer is **"adventure."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence is about Abraham narrating a past experience to Reshma in a dramatic way. • The word** "escapade"** implies that the experience was thrilling or exciting. (दुःसाहसिक घटना) • **Example**: *Her latest **escapade**__ was to camp outside a department store on the night before the sale.* • **"Adventure"** is the most appropriate option that conveys the same meaning as** "escapade."** • **"Adventure" **means an experience or event that is very unusual, exciting or dangerous. (असाधारण, उत्तेजक और संकटपूर्ण अनुभव या घटना) __ • **Example**: *Our journey through the jungle was quite an **adventure**__!* • The correct answer is option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, exertion**, means physical or mental effort. (अत्‍यधिक शारीरिक प्रयास; थकाने वाला काम) • **Option 2, ordeal**, means a difficult or painful experience. (अत्‍यंत अप्रिय या कठिन अनुभव, अग्नि-परीक्षा) • **Option 4, escape**, means the act of escaping. (पलायन; भागने की क्रिया) 2f:Tb5a, The correct answer is** "flair."**
